title: Kindle Highlight Export Freshness
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:highlight source_app="kindle" highlight_epoch=* export_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((export_epoch-highlight_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by source_app
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures Kindle export lag by source app for highlight syncs.
value: Lag tracking shows which source app create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside highlight syncs.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `Kindle export lag` on `reading:highlight` events and aggregate them by `source_app`.
visualization: Table of source app with average and worst Kindle export lag.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how long things take for each source app so you can see where highlight syncs slows down.
